questions.q: Why SvelteKit SSG instead of Next.js or WordPress?
questions.a: SvelteKit Static Site Generation (SSG) compiles HTML at build time with minimal to zero client-side JavaScript. This eliminates the hydration overhead found in Next.js and the database latency of WordPress, guaranteeing instantaneous load times that Google rewards.

questions.q: How does the Google Indexing API benefit my business?
questions.a: Unlike traditional sitemaps where you wait for Google to crawl your site, the Indexing API allows us to notify Google of new or updated pages instantly. This leads to near-real-time indexation, which is a massive competitive advantage.

questions.q: What is 'Zero JS' and why is it important for SEO?
questions.a: Zero JS means the page is functional without needing to download or execute heavy JavaScript. Since Google uses a 'second pass' for rendering JS-heavy sites, Zero JS ensures your content is indexed immediately and accurately on the first crawl.

questions.q: How do you ensure security on a Headless stack?
questions.a: By separating the frontend from the backend (Headless), we eliminate common attack vectors like SQL injection and cross-site scripting (XSS) prevalent in WordPress. We also use Cloudflare WAF for enterprise-grade protection.

questions.q: Do you offer migration from WordPress or Joomla?
questions.a: Yes, we specialize in 'heart transplants'—moving your content and SEO authority from heavy legacy CMS platforms to fast modern engines without losing any ranking positions.

questions.q: How do you handle third-party scripts like Google Analytics?
questions.a: We strictly enforce Partytown compliance. Scripts run in a background web worker, ensuring they never block the main thread or degrade your Core Web Vitals scores.
